turns.en: One, two, three, four, five, six, seven, eight, nine.

turns.speaker: A
turns.nl: Dank u. Wat is uw vraag?
turns.en: Thank you. What is your question?

turns.speaker: you
turns.nl: Ik snap het bedrag niet. Kunt u het uitleggen?
turns.en: I don't understand the amount. Can you explain it?

turns.speaker: A
turns.nl: U moet 200 euro betalen vóór 1 augustus.
turns.en: You have to pay 200 euros before the 1st of August.

turns.speaker: you
turns.nl: Kan ik in termijnen betalen?
turns.en: Can I pay in instalments?

turns.speaker: A
turns.nl: Ja, dat kunt u online regelen.
turns.en: Yes, you can arrange that online.

turns.speaker: you
turns.nl: Fijn, dank u wel.
turns.en: Great, thank you.

roleplays.scenario: A colleague tells you about the news. React and talk about what happened.

turns.speaker: A
turns.nl: Heb je het nieuws gisteren gezien?
turns.en: Did you see the news yesterday?

turns.speaker: you
turns.nl: Nee, wat is er gebeurd?
turns.en: No, what happened?

turns.speaker: A
turns.nl: Er was een grote storm in het noorden.
turns.en: There was a big storm in the north.

turns.speaker: you
turns.nl: Echt? Was er veel schade?
turns.en: Really? Was there much damage?

turns.speaker: A
turns.nl: Ja, veel bomen zijn omgewaaid.
turns.en: Yes, many trees blew down.

turns.speaker: you
turns.nl: Wat erg. Ik kijk vanavond het journaal.
turns.en: How awful. I'll watch the news tonight.

turns.en: Good idea. It was on Nu.nl too.
